title: Lockup: New Mexico: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — War
Prison officials initiate a shakedown after gang members in Level 6 overpower an officer in the recreation area, take her keys and stab a rival gang member; this type of incident simply adds to the tension already felt in the supermax facility.

title: Lockup: New Mexico: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Get Out and Stay Out
For some inmates, the only way out of prison is "paroling legit," or leaving in a body bag; others earn a lump sum of good time by completing programs or holding a prison job, while a few will take any chance to try to escape.

title: Lockup: Louisville: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Enough is Enough
A repeat offender smuggles in contraband and an inmate becomes a marked man after murdering a Louisville rap star; a prescription pill epidemic takes its toll on the jail and drug use on the inside could keep another inmate from leaving.

title: Lockup: Wabash: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Da Future
With over 2,000 inmates, the Wabash Valley Correctional Facility has a larger population and more acreage than the small town in which it's located; after a decade in confinement, one of Indiana's most infamous inmates moves to general population.

title: Lockup: Wabash: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Father Figure
The killer of a corrections officer fights to be freed from 16 years of solitary confinement, and boyhood friends struggle to parent their kids from behind prison walls; but one, cut-off from visits with his son, is on a razor's edge.

title: Lockup: Oakland: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — To PC or Not to PC
A celebrity rapper enters the Santa Rita jail, but his arrest leaves a heartbroken girlfriend behind; two brothers deal with gangs, drugs and parenthood and a three-time convicted murderer claims he's killed others as well.

title: Lockup: Colorado: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — The Hustle
Prison is an underground economy, where some deals are signed in ink and others are signed in blood; a rare look at the schemes, hustles and extortions conducted behind prison walls and the consequences they carry.

title: American Greed
description:
S5 E3 — Fool's Gold
Philanthropist, diplomat, international man of mystery, and criminal Dr Henry Jones led a double-life that was unknown to all he knew.

title: American Greed
description:
S5 E6 — $1.2 Billion Scam: Ft. Frauderdale
Scott Rothstein, a Ft. Lauderdale attorney making millions, is the life of the party and a guy who wants the world to love him, while also secretly playing the part of criminal mastermind.

title: American Greed
description:
S13 E15 — All-Star Sports Scam
Well-heeled financial advisor Peggy Ann Fulford builds a cache of all-star clients and a personal fortune by convincing A-list players like Dennis Rodman that she's in their corner.

title: American Greed
description:
S13 E16 — Judgment of Terror
When a judge in Texas is shot four times, a tip leads investigators to Chimene Onyeri, an aspiring Houston rap artist facing prison after his crooked card skimming plots are exposed.

title: American Greed
description:
S15 E7 — The Polygamist and the Bio Fuel Baron
CEO Jacob Kingston appears to be a rising star in Utah's fledgling biofuel industry, until a member of a secretive polygamist group called The Order reveals that Kingston is committing a 1.1 billion dollar fraud.

title: American Greed
description:
S15 E9 — COVID Cons
While an estimated $100 billion in COVID relief funds is stolen, this seasoned family of fraudsters easily grabs millions of dollars Americans desperately need to buy themselves mansions, jewelry and gold.

title: American Greed
description:
S10 E3 — A Mother's Costly Revenge
A financial fraudster seeks deadly revenge after being placed behind bars for propositioning his assistant's daughter.

title: American Greed
description:
S7 E3 — The Prisoner of Wall Street
A man is convicted of wire fraud and money laundering after claiming to sell coffee futures.

title: American Greed
description:
S7 E6 — Union Bu$ter; The Fool's Gold
Construction workers unwittingly foot the bill for Melissa King's lifestyle; a smooth-talking ladies-man creates a phony gold scheme.

title: American Greed
description:
S11 E19 — Lesson in Greed; Soldier Scam
A school supply vendor steals millions from Detroit public schools by enlisting shady school officials; crooks use photos of real military men to lure women into sending them love and money.
